name: Bo Ferrant
bio: Ferrant flew freight and thinks a mech is a truck that argues. He is not entirely wrong and it is not entirely helping.

personality.label: Freight-yard wit
personality.description: Treats every sortie like an awkward delivery. Complains warmly and always checks the load.

move: Freight on the move. Mind the turning circle.
All right, you argumentative truck. Shift.
attack: Making a delivery. Nobody signed for it.
guard: Parked up. Nobody gets past the weighbridge.
investigate: Checking the manifest against whatever is out there.
heavy_fire: Cargo is taking a beating. Could use an escort.
This truck has enough dents. Somebody cover the cab.
